_comment: Adapter-specific declarations for the fleet tooling (Entwicklung/scripts). They live HERE so that a change in this adapter never touches the locked tooling. Readers: sync-iopackage-from-i18n.py (manifestI18n, release gate B03) and submit-stable.py (forumThread). Keys starting with an underscore are comments.

manifestI18n._comment: instanceObjects id -> key in admin/i18n/<lang>.json. Every manifest object needs a `name` entry (an object without one is a structural error, and so is an entry whose object no longer exists); `desc` only where the name does not already say it - an empty desc beats an invented sentence.
manifestI18n._note: Only the two standard objects; the device datapoints are created at runtime (main.ts, tName/tDesc/tRaw).

_listenPorts: Every port the adapter opens. `key` is a native key only for primary/secondary; for shared and perDevice it is a label. fakeroku has no primary port: each emulated Roku carries its own ECP port in native.devices[], and SSDP 1900 is shared on purpose (declaring it as native.port would warn every UPnP user on the host).
